verdict.rationale: Square offers extensive APIs covering payments, catalog, inventory, orders, locations, disputes, payouts, webhooks, and even an official MCP server, suggesting broad API-UI parity for core commerce operations. However, evidence doesn't confirm full parity—no OpenAPI spec is discoverable via probes, and dashboard-only features like team scheduling/payroll UI or nuanced receipt customization aren't confirmed as fully API-accessible. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that every dashboard UI action (team management, payroll, engagement programs, cash flow management) has a corresponding API endpoint, a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec, and independent/hands-on verification that API and UI are truly at parity rather than API being a subset.
